messages:
ops-alert-bot: alert: gpu-node-43 (gpu-7) reported ECC count spike + repeated Xid 13/31 errors — auto-drain triggered. Pod eviction started. Please triage :rotating_light:
maria: copying logs now. starting `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and grabbing kernel Xid lines. tagging @kevin for serial/warranty check
kevin: on it. quick check: `sudo dmidecode | grep -i serial` returned S/N: RWI-9X1C-3421. vendor warranty portal shows coverage until 2026-09 but there are two earlier RMA entries from 2025, need to reconcile.
samir: thanks. is this node in eu-west or us-west? routing matters for spares.
maria: node is in eu-west-1 (FRA). current pods are drained to other nodes, cost of failed-task restarts minimal. :thumbsup:
ops-alert-bot: drain window started at 1978272950. estimated remaining drain: ~90s. autoscaler holding new placements.
kevin: vendor ticket 892221 opened (pending serial confirmation). they flagged "warranty note: prior repair" so they want full manifest + PO. I'll attach the cluster asset CSV.
joel: note: FRA customs has been slow last week. recommend cross-dock to AMS then courier to FRA depot to avoid extra hold. that adds ~18-24h but lower risk than direct sea.
maria: logs snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:18:00): 31, PID=8753, Channel 000
[ 1234.768901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:18:00): 13
2026-02-28 11:03:45 ECC single-bit corrected errors: 72 -> 318
```
kevin: looks flaky/hard ECC. we'll RMA the card. can we use a hot-spare from the regional pool to minimize capacity impact?
samir: eu-west spare pool has 3 available (quantized cards) but two are earmarked for reserved capacity customers tonight. one is free but untagged for warranty rotation.
joel: if we requisition that spare, we need pick ticket + manifest + serial swap recorded in warehouse. logistics-bot please confirm pick/pack ETA.
logistics-bot: pickup slot available for FRA cross-dock at 2026-03-01 09:00 CET. ETA to depot after cross-dock: 18-26h. shipping method: courier express. I will attach AWB when created.
tara: I'll escalate vendor ticket to TAM and request an advance replacement to FRA depot (explain prior repairs). also need PO# 4312-RED-2024 attached to the RMA. Kevin please confirm you attached the CSV and PO. :pray:
kevin: attached both to ticket 892221 and included cluster audit link. requested TAM escalation now.
maria: for the node remediation runbook: 1) confirm spare serial mapped to node asset tag 2) update k8s node annotation `rwi/replaced_gpu_serial` 3) run `gpu-health-check --full` after swap 4) close vendor ticket with depot manifest. I'll paste the commands below.
maria: runbook snippet:
```
# annotate node
kubectl annotate node gpu-node-43 rwi/replaced_gpu_serial=RWI-SPARE-001
# health check
gpu-health-check --full --node gpu-node-43
# verify ECC reset
nvidia-smi -i 7 -q | grep -i ECC
```
samir: side note for capacity planning: should we flag a temporary increase to 1.2x spare buffer in eu-west until vendor lead times stabilize? last month median replacement lead time jumped from 24h -> 72h.
joel: +1. ops-cost will see a small bump, but avoids degraded SLA for reserved customers. I'll open a ticket with finance to model the change.
kevin: vendor replied: they will dispatch replacement once depot manifest + PO are confirmed. they asked if we can accept a refurbished unit; warranty covers it but we prefer new if available. escalating.
maria: keeping this thread updated. current status: node drained, spare reserved pending pick/pack, vendor ticket escalated. next update when AWB is created or if vendor changes ETA. :eyes:
